description:
Commit 3f48e3b claims 'wiremock smoke tests for production methods' but the actual coverage is ~60%. Methods with zero smoke-test coverage:

- chat_contact_* (5 methods in contact.rs) — no contact_smoke_tests.rs
- custom_emoji_* (5 methods in custom_emoji.rs) — no custom_emoji_smoke_tests.rs
- quota_get, quota_changes — no quota_smoke_tests.rs
- blob_lookup, blob_convert — no blob_smoke_tests.rs
- space_ban_* (4 methods)
- space_invite_* (4 methods)
- read_position_get / update / changes
- presence_status_get / update / changes
- push_subscription_create / update / destroy
- space_join (chat-specific, non-/set shape)
- space_update (only space create/destroy/query tested)
- message_query_changes
- chat_update non-muted paths (name, description, add_members, remove_members, update_member_roles)
- ChatCreateInput::Channel variant (also see JMAP-26di.1)
- BodyType::Rich (only text/plain and text/markdown tested)

Either narrow the commit message scope or file follow-up beads to fill the gaps. The mail-client canonical sibling has per-method coverage; chat-client should match before publishing.
title: ~40% of public SessionClient methods have no smoke-test coverage
